title: Working Zones Introduction and Seal Ring's Housing
topics: Bearing and seal ring assembly with same fitting diameter
Introduction radii for seals and bearings
Surface finish requirements for seal seats
rules: Introduction zone must have fillet radius R based on diameter: ød ≤ 60 → R=0.4, >60 to ≤120 → R=0.8, >120 → R=1.2
Minimum effective dimension a=1 (minimum effective), used when dimensions don't allow larger dimensioning, otherwise a = s ≥ 2mm
For bearing and seal ring with same diameter (dc = da): seal ring assembly must be followed by bearing assembly
All zone 'L' must be dimensioned with the bearing's fitting diameter (or similar)
On specific zones must remain the specifications of roughness assigned, indicating useful length of execution
Every zone must indicate the specific tolerance and roughness values
Sharp edges must be rounded with indication 'rounded edge a/o rounded side'
Surfaces possibly with plunge grinding machining and without roughness a/o helical riflinge
dimensions: Introduction radius R: 0.4 mm (ød ≤ 60), 0.8 mm (60 < ød ≤ 120), 1.2 mm (ød > 120)
Zone L dimensioned based on bearing fitting diameter
tolerances: Specific tolerance values must be indicated for every zone
Tolerance for bearing fitting diameter applies to zone L
surface_finish: Roughness specifications must remain assigned on specific zones with useful length indicated
Surface possibly with plunge grinding machining
Rounded edges required (sharp edges not allowed)
inspection: Verify introduction radii R according to diameter ranges
Verify minimum effective dimension a=1 or a=s≥2mm
Verify roughness values on specified zones
manufacturing_notes: Assembly sequence critical: seal ring first, then bearing when dc=da
Introduction zones facilitate seal and bearing installation
Plunge grinding preferred for seal seat surfaces
Avoid helical machining marks on seal seats
training_guidance: When modeling housing seal seats in NX, apply introduction chamfer/radius based on bore diameter: R0.4 for ød≤60mm, R0.8 for 60<ød≤120mm, R1.2 for ød>120mm
Model working zone 'a' with minimum 1mm effective length, prefer 2mm or greater when space allows
For combined bearing/seal seats with same diameter, dimension the seal seat zone L using the bearing tolerance class
Apply edge break or rounding to all sharp edges at seal seat transitions
Annotate seal seat zones with specific roughness callouts over defined axial lengths
Ensure assembly sequence annotations specify seal-then-bearing order when diameters match
Model seal seat surfaces suitable for plunge grinding (no helical tool paths)
Always dimension and tolerance each functional zone of the seal seat separately
summary: This standard defines the geometry and dimensioning requirements for seal ring housing working zones in Bonfiglioli housings. Key rules include diameter-dependent introduction radii (R=0.4 to 1.2mm), minimum effective dimensions (a≥1mm), and mandatory edge rounding. When bearing and seal share the same fitting diameter, the seal must be assembled first and zone L dimensioned per the bearing tolerance. All zones require specific tolerance and roughness callouts, with plunge-ground surfaces preferred.
